text: Driver event at author-study 0: the accepted research review (research-review 1, PASS) left six advisories, RES-008 to RES-013, including RES-008 (the interpretation-3 anagogy reverses Rabanus, PL 107 cols. 947-948) and RES-009 (Hilary and Chrysostom credited with the whole controlling claim).
